ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate optimal irrigation volumes and plan machinery routes, but agricultural engineers still visit the field to decide whether a solution fits the land and whether farmers can use it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 1,700 agricultural engineers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 1,800 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 100 jobs and about 100 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $84,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural engineers, but it will upgrade how they work. AI and smart-agriculture platforms greatly accelerate irrigation optimization, machinery selection, and yield forecasting, reducing roles focused only on manual design calculations. Engineers create value through field implementation: adapting solutions to local conditions, directing construction, and communicating with farmers. AI cannot replace this hands-on fieldwork.
ai_s2_accel: AI precision-irrigation decisions
Autonomous agricultural machinery and driving
Drone crop protection and growth monitoring
Smart environmental control for protected agriculture
ai_s2_auto: Automated irrigation quotas and pipe-network calculations
Batch generation of CAD drawings and plans
Automated organization of agricultural weather and soil data
Preparation of project documentation and acceptance reports
ai_s3_list: Adapt to local conditions: the same design requires changes for different fields.
Field judgment: assess soil, terrain, and water sources together.
Construction management: monitor quality and coordinate farmers and contractors.
Farmer communication: explain engineering plans in practical language.
Electromechanical knowledge: select the right machinery and equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI and software increasingly handle the calculation side of agricultural engineering, including irrigation, equipment selection, and weather data. Field implementation, construction, commissioning, and farmer use still depend on experience and have limited automation, placing exposure in the middle.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Use AI as an assistant. Improve designs with smart-irrigation decisions and build stronger benefit analyses with data. At the same time, deepen field experience. Even the best AI calculation still needs someone to install the solution in the ground.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Agricultural engineering is a specialized field with favorable direction: competition is limited and policy support is strong. Understand that the work involves fields, not only offices. Build electromechanical and data-analysis skills and pursue smart agriculture.

Move toward smart agriculture and intelligent machinery. Learn precision irrigation and drone monitoring while developing both design and implementation skills. Professional registration or credentials can support advancement and higher project income.

People with water-resources, electromechanical, or civil engineering backgrounds can transition smoothly. In interviews, emphasize field readiness, drawing skills, and equipment knowledge. Irrigation or machinery project experience is especially valuable.

Agricultural engineers are difficult to recruit. Consider candidates from electromechanical and water-resources fields. Field allowances and project revenue sharing help retain engineers more effectively than mission-driven messaging alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time temperature, humidity, and soil-moisture monitoring

ai_s7_trends: Smart agriculture and intelligent machinery become national investment priorities.
Precision irrigation, drones, and autonomous agricultural machinery enter wider use.
Versatile agricultural engineers with both field and data skills become more valuable.

body: Agricultural engineers apply engineering principles to agricultural production, planning, designing, and implementing field water systems, machinery, protected agriculture, and agricultural-product processing to improve productivity and sustainability.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate optimal irrigation volumes and plan machinery routes, but agricultural engineers still visit the field to decide whether a solution fits the land and whether farmers can use it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最优灌溉量、能规划农机路径，但「这片地到底适不适合这套方案、农户会不会用」，还得农业工程师下地去看。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业工程师在岗约 0.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.18 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.46 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农业工程师，但会升级工作方式：灌溉优化、农机选型、产量预测这些环节正被 AI 和智能农业平台大幅加速，纯手工设计计算的岗位在减少。农业工程师的价值转向田间落地——因地制宜调方案、指导施工、跟农户沟通，这些「脚踩泥土」的工作，AI 替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 精准灌溉决策
无人农机与自动驾驶作业
无人机植保与长势监测
设施农业环境智能控制
ai_s2_auto: 灌溉定额与管网计算自动化
CAD 图纸与方案批量生成
农业气象与土壤数据自动整理
项目文档与验收报告编制
ai_s3_list: 因地制宜：同一套设计在不同地块要改。
田间判断：土壤、地形、水源的综合评估。
施工管理：盯质量、协调农户与施工队。
农户沟通：把工程方案讲成农户听得懂的话。
机电功底：农机与设备选型不出错。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明农业工程的「计算面」正在被 AI 和软件接管——灌溉、选型、气象数据都是 AI 主场；但工程的落地环节（施工、调试、农户使用）依赖现场经验，自动化程度有限，所以评分居中。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 AI 当助手用起来：用智能灌溉决策提升方案质量，用数据分析做出更扎实的效益评估；同时把田间经验做深——「AI 算得再好，也要有人把它装到地里」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 农业工程是「冷门但方向好」的专业：就业竞争小、政策支持大；提醒孩子这行要下地，不是纯办公室工作；把机电和数据分析学好，往智能农业方向走，前景更好。
往智能农业和农机智能化靠：学会用精准灌溉、无人机监测等工具，把「设计+落地」两条腿都走实；考注册或职称，带项目收入会上一个台阶。
有水利、机电、土木背景的人转农业工程很顺；面试时突出「能下地+会画图+懂设备」，有农机或灌溉项目经验的优先。
农业工程人才难招，建议从机电和水利行业跨界挖人；给下地补贴和项目分成，把「田埂上的工程师」留住，比只谈情怀有用。

ai_s7_trends: 智能农业与农机智能化成为国家投入重点。
精准灌溉、无人机与无人农机加速落地。
能下地又会数据的复合农业工程师更吃香。

body: 农业工程师运用工程学原理解决农业生产问题，从事农田水利、农业机械、设施农业、农产品加工等领域的规划、设计与实施，提升农业的生产效率与可持续性。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the best match, but at the moment of birth, a breeder still has to feel the animal's temperature and breathing by hand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 7,900 animal breeders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 8,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with roughly 1,200 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $52,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace animal breeders, but it will change how they select breeding pairs. Breeders once relied on observation and reputation to judge whether two animals were a good match. Genetic testing and algorithms now provide evidence-based recommendations. Pregnancy care, delivery, and newborn care still happen on site, where machines cannot take over.
ai_s2_accel: Genetic testing and algorithms that recommend breeding pairs and reduce hereditary disease risk
Smart climate control and birthing-area monitoring with automatic alerts for abnormalities
AI image recognition that supports early health assessments of young animals
Cloud health records and remote veterinary consultations
ai_s2_auto: Digital pedigree registration and lineage management with records available in one click
Estrus and pregnancy tracking software that automatically flags key milestones
Automated collection of feeding records and health data
Automated reporting for breeding and sales records
ai_s3_list: Observing and caring for individual animals: noticing poor appetite or an unusual look before anyone else does.
Delivery and emergency-care experience: hands-on intervention during a difficult birth and calming the mother afterward cannot be automated.
Breeding judgment and long-term planning: genetic reports provide guidance, but people must decide the direction of the population.
Communication and trust with owners: promising the quality of a young animal and placing a life in a customer's care depend on reputation.
Responsibility and respect for life: when a newborn has a problem, the emotional and professional costs are both real.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means about half of this occupation's tasks are desk-based, including pedigrees, records, and breeding-pair analysis. Software and genetic technology are taking over more of this work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate AI exposure does not mean high risk. As AI improves breeding-pair selection, breeders who understand genetics and can apply the recommendations become more important. Informal breeders who rely on intuition and keep no records face the greatest pressure, while skilled professionals become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study animal science, livestock production, or veterinary technology, with an emphasis on animal breeding and genetics. Get hands-on experience at a reputable breeding operation. In the AI era, breeders who understand genetic testing and pedigree management will stand out.

Build skills in genetic testing, pedigree software, and health-data analysis instead of relying only on experience. Learn to plan a population with data so you can move from hands-on care into breeding expertise.

Without a formal background, start in newborn care or as an assistant while earning a relevant animal-health credential. Highlight measurable outcomes such as survival rates, pedigree completeness, and health management on your resume.

Do not hire breeders based only on their love of animals. Evaluate their technical background and data skills. Candidates who can interpret genetic reports, maintain pedigree records, and handle overnight shifts during breeding season are stronger investments.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Pedigree tracking, breeding plans, and birth registration
Hereditary disease risk, breed ancestry, and breeding-pair recommendations
Temperature and humidity monitoring, abnormal-condition alerts, and overnight monitoring
Cloud-based vaccination, deworming, and examination records
Image recognition that helps identify developmental abnormalities
ai_s6_tools.工具: AI health screening for young animals

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Pedigree registration, certificate processing, and traceable data
Customer records, reservation management, and reputation building

ai_s7_trends: Genetic testing and AI-assisted pairing are becoming standard at reputable breeding operations, replacing intuition-based pairing with data-driven breeding.
As the pet economy scales, compliance requirements are displacing informal home breeding, while professional facilities and branded operators lead the market.
The breeder's role is becoming a combination of breeding-data manager and hands-on neonatal care specialist, creating a clear premium for technically skilled workers.

body: Animal breeders select breeding pairs, care for animals during and after pregnancy, raise young animals, maintain health and pedigree records, and use tools such as genetic testing to improve a population's genetic quality. The occupation sits between livestock production and the pet economy.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the best match, but at the moment of birth, a breeder still has to feel the animal's temperature and breathing by hand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最佳配对，但接生那一刻的体温和呼吸，还得靠饲养员的手去感觉。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年动物饲养员在岗约 0.79 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.81 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.20 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代动物饲养员，但会改变「选配」这件事的做法。以前靠眼力和口碑判断两只动物配不配，现在基因检测加算法能给出科学建议。剩下的孕期照护、接生、幼崽保育全是现场活，机器进不来也顶不住。
ai_s2_accel: 基因检测 + 算法给出选配建议，规避遗传病
智能温控与产房监控，异常自动告警
AI 图像识别辅助判断幼崽健康状态
云端健康档案与远程兽医会诊
ai_s2_auto: 血统登记与谱系管理电子化，档案一键可查
发情期与孕期追踪软件自动提醒关键节点
喂养记录与健康数据的自动采集
繁殖与销售记录的报表自动化
ai_s3_list: 对个体动物的观察与照料：哪只食欲不振、哪只眼神不对，一眼看出问题。
接生与急救经验：难产时的手法处理、产后母兽的安抚，机器替代不了。
选育判断与长期规划：基因报告是参考，种群的整体走向要靠人拍板。
与主人的沟通与信任：承诺一只幼崽的品质，把生命交给客户，靠的是口碑。
对生命的责任与敬畏：新生命出了问题，承受的是情感与职业双重代价。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在桌面完成——谱系、记录、选配分析，这些正被软件和基因技术接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。选配这件事 AI 越强，越需要懂基因、能落地的饲养员去执行。真正被挤压的是「靠感觉硬配、没有记录」的散户式繁育，专业育种人反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读畜牧兽医、动物科学相关专业，重点学动物繁育学和遗传学，多去正规繁育场实习。AI 时代，懂基因检测和谱系管理的饲养员会越来越吃香。
把基因检测、谱系软件和健康数据分析补起来，别停留在「凭经验配种」。学会用数据规划种群，才能从体力型饲养员升级为育种专家。
没有专业背景就从幼崽护理或助手做起，同时考宠物医疗相关的职业证书。简历上多写「成活率、谱系完整度、健康管理」这类可量化成果。
招饲养员别只看「爱动物」，要看技术背景和数据能力。能读基因报告、会管谱系档案、能扛住繁殖季夜班的候选人，比单纯有爱心的人更值得投入。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 谱系追踪、配种计划、出生登记
遗传病风险、血统纯度、选配建议
关键节点提醒、日历管理
温湿度监测、异常告警、夜间值守
免疫、驱虫、体检记录云端化
图像识别辅助发现发育异常
血统登记、证书办理、数据可追溯
客户档案、预订管理、口碑沉淀

ai_s7_trends: 基因检测与 AI 选配成为正规繁育场的标配，「凭感觉配种」被数据化育种取代。
宠物经济规模化，散户式家庭繁殖被合规化淘汰，专业繁育场与品牌化经营主导市场。
饲养员角色升级为「育种数据管理者 + 现场保育专家」双核，懂技术的从业者溢价明显。

body: 动物饲养员负责动物的繁殖选配、孕期与产后护理、幼崽培育、健康与血统记录，并通过基因检测等技术手段优化种群的遗传质量，是介于畜牧生产与宠物经济之间的专业岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最佳配对，但接生那一刻的体温和呼吸，还得靠饲养员的手去感觉。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automation can bake standardized bread, but bakers still determine flavor, shape dough by hand, and develop new products.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 249,100 bakers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 263,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 14,100 jobs, with approximately 39,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $36,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bakers, but it will reduce standardized production roles. Central kitchens and automated lines mass-produce toast and rolls, shifting bakers from standard volume toward flavor development, artisan bread, and in-store experiences. People limited to basic mass production face the most pressure, while bakers with product-development skills and craftsmanship become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Recipe simulation
Fermentation monitoring
Demand forecasting
Loss optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated dough mixing
Tunnel-oven baking
Automated dividing and shaping
Central kitchen mass production
ai_s3_list: Flavor judgment: human taste remains essential.
Hand shaping: human touch remains essential.
New product development: human creativity remains essential.
In-store experience: people provide warmth.
Quality control: human eyes remain essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, places this career in a low AI-exposure craft area. Baking depends heavily on touch and experience, which systems cannot yet replicate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Standard mass-production tasks face replacement, while flavor-development roles do not. Bakers with strong craft and product-development skills become scarcer, while those limited to basic mass production face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with vocational baking education and practice tactile judgment and recipe work. Pure mass production is shrinking in the AI era, so develop product-development skills early.
Advance from producing volume to creating flavor and developing products, with a path toward head baker or an independent shop.
Emphasize tactile skill and the range of products you can make. Shops value consistency and quality control.
When hiring, assess more than speed. Flavor judgment and consistent output matter, and core bakers with those skills merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Central kitchens expand and standardized roles shrink.
Premium products and distinctive flavors create opportunities.
Bakers with product-development skills are more sought after.

body: Bakers mix, ferment, shape, and bake dough according to recipes to produce bread, pastries, and other baked goods. They control oven temperature and time to maintain consistent quality and flavor.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automation can bake standardized bread, but bakers still determine flavor, shape dough by hand, and develop new products.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动化能烤标准面包，但风味判断、手工整形和研发新品，还是烘焙师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年面包师在岗约 24.91 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 26.32 万人，净增约 1.41 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.99 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代面包师，但会压缩标准岗。中央厨房和自动化产线把吐司、餐包量产化，面包师从「做标准量」挪向「风味研发、手工欧包、门店体验」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础量产的人，有研发和手艺的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 配方模拟
发酵监控
需求预测
损耗优化
ai_s2_auto: 自动和面
隧道炉烘烤
自动分割整形
中央厨房量产
ai_s3_list: 风味判断：舌头靠人。
手工整形：手感靠人。
新品研发：创意靠人。
现场体验：温度靠人。
品质把关：眼睛靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的手工区——烘焙高度依赖手感和经验，系统暂时接不住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「标准量产」动作，不是「风味研发」的岗位。有手艺、能研发的人，反而更稀缺。怕的是只会做基础量产。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校烘焙起步多练手感和配方，AI 时代纯量产在缩，早点练研发。
从「做出货」升级成「做风味 + 研发」，往主厨或自有店走。
突出手感和出品种类，门店看重稳和品控。
选人别只看速度，要看风味判断和稳定出品，骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 中央厨房普及，标准岗缩。
精品与风味带来机会。
有研发力的面包师更抢手。

body: 面包师按配方完成面团的混合、发酵、整形与烘烤，制作面包及糕点等烘焙食品，控制炉温与时间，保证出品稳定与风味。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动化能烤标准面包，但风味判断、手工整形和研发新品，还是烘焙师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can clean data and organize documents, but CRCs still need to understand why participants withdraw and persuade them to return for follow-up. People are the hardest variable in clinical trials.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Clinical Research Coordinators is projected to rise from about 104,300 in 2024 to 108,200 in 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with around 8,500 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $161,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Clinical Research Coordinators, but it will reshape their work. EDC systems and AI increasingly replace CRF entry, data cleaning, and document organization, reducing the value of data-only CRC roles. Participant recruitment and retention, compliance communication, and Site operations still depend heavily on relationships and on-site judgment. The role is shifting toward trial-operations expertise.
ai_s2_accel: AI matching for participant recruitment
Real-time trial-data quality monitoring
Electronic informed consent (e-consent)
AI-assisted risk monitoring
ai_s2_auto: Automated CRF data entry and validation
Automated data cleaning and query handling
Template-based trial document management
Visit reminders and scheduling systems
ai_s3_list: Participant communication: explain the protocol clearly and retain participants.
Compliance judgment: identify and address GCP boundary issues.
Data stewardship: remain accountable for data authenticity and completeness.
Stakeholder coordination: connect investigators, sponsors, and ethics committees.
On-site response: handle adverse events and unexpected situations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure tier. Systems increasingly replace standardized tasks such as data entry, cleaning, and documentation, narrowing data-only roles. Participant management and Site operations still depend on relationships. The transition follows a clear division: AI manages data while people manage people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure signals the need to evolve beyond data entry. Focus on participant communication, compliance knowledge, and Site operations, then progress toward senior CRC, CRA, or project-management roles. Relationships and judgment form the career's strongest moat.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Clinical research offers an accessible path into the pharmaceutical industry for people with clinical, nursing, or pharmacy backgrounds, and a bachelor's degree is often sufficient. Build GCP and statistics fundamentals, then pursue internships at hospital clinical-research centers or CROs. Experience can lead toward monitoring and project management.

Master digital tools such as EDC and risk-monitoring platforms, then devote the saved time to participant management and Site operations. After building project experience, pursue advanced credentials and move toward senior CRC, CRA, or trial-project-manager roles for stronger income and resilience.

People with nursing, pharmacy, or clinical backgrounds can transition into CRC work quickly. Highlight GCP training, data-management experience, and communication cases rather than only form-filling ability. Candidates without that background can begin as research assistants while earning credentials.

Heavy data-entry workloads and limited growth drive high CRC turnover. Equip teams with EDC and AI tools so people can focus on participant management. Clear paths into CRA and project-management roles help retain experienced coordinators.

ai_s7_trends: Full digitization of data workflows shifts CRCs toward operations expertise.
Participant recruitment and retention become core competitive skills.
CROs and pharmaceutical companies need more multidisciplinary coordinators.

body: Clinical Research Coordinators manage daily operations at clinical-trial Sites. Their work includes participant recruitment, enrollment, and follow-up; case report form completion and data verification; trial document management; and ethics and regulatory coordination.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can clean data and organize documents, but CRCs still need to understand why participants withdraw and persuade them to return for follow-up. People are the hardest variable in clinical trials.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动清理数据、整理文档，但「受试者为什么脱落、怎么说服他按时回访」——临床试验里最难的变量是人，得靠 CRC。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年临床研究协调员在岗约 10.43 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.82 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代临床研究协调员，但会重构工作内容：CRF 录入、数据清理、文档整理正被 EDC 和 AI 大幅替代，纯数据型 CRC 的价值在缩水。剩下的核心——受试者招募与维护、合规沟通、中心运营——高度依赖人际和现场判断，AI 替代不了，岗位向「试验运营专家」转型。
ai_s2_accel: 受试者招募 AI 匹配
试验数据实时质量监控
知情同意电子化(E-consent)
风险监控 AI 辅助
ai_s2_auto: CRF 数据自动录入与校验
数据清理与质疑自动化
试验文档模板化管理
访视提醒与排期系统
ai_s3_list: 受试者沟通：把方案讲清、把人留住。
合规判断：GCP 红线事项的识别与处理。
数据把关：数据真实性与完整性的责任。
多方协调：研究者、申办方、伦理的衔接。
现场应变：不良事件与突发情况的处置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明 CRC 是「中高曝光」的临床研究岗位：数据录入、清理、文档等标准化环节正被系统替代，纯数据型工作空间收窄；但受试者管理和中心运营依赖人际，属于「AI 管数据，人管人」的转型期岗位，抗替代性在人际部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒 CRC 转型：别只当「数据录入员」，把精力放在受试者沟通、合规理解、中心运营上，往资深 CRC、CRA 和项目管理走——人际和判断力才是这行真正的护城河。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 临床研究是医药行业里相对「性价比高」的赛道：临床、护理、药学背景都能进，本科学历够用。建议孩子学好 GCP 和统计基础，实习争取进医院临床研究中心或 CRO，积累后往监查员和项目管理走，路径清晰。
把 EDC、风险监控等数字化工具用熟，把时间花在受试者管理和中心运营上；积累项目经验后考取更高认证，往资深 CRC、CRA、试验项目经理转型，收入和不可替代性都更高。
有护理、药学或临床背景的转 CRC 上手快；求职时突出 GCP 培训、数据管理经验和沟通案例，别只强调「能填表」。没背景的可以从研究助理做起，边干边考认证。
CRC 流失率高的主因是「数据录入型工作量大、成长感低」：建议配好 EDC 和 AI 工具，把人解放到受试者管理上；给 CRC 清晰的 CRA、项目管理晋升通道，留住有经验的人。

ai_s6_tools.工具: EDC 电子数据采集系统

ai_s7_trends: 数据环节全面数字化，CRC 向运营专家转型。
受试者招募与保留成为核心竞争力。
CRO 与药企对综合协调人才需求增长。

body: 临床研究协调员在临床试验机构中负责试验中心的日常运营与协调，包括受试者招募、入组与随访管理、病例报告表填写与数据核实、试验文档管理、伦理与监管对接。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动清理数据、整理文档，但「受试者为什么脱落、怎么说服他按时回访」——临床试验里最难的变量是人，得靠 CRC。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can create a costume list instantly and a scan can locate every garment, but when an actor's waistband splits three minutes before the show, your hands still have to sew it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 6,700 Costume Attendants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 7,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 1,800 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $54,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Costume Attendants, but it will take over records, lists, and stockroom management. Alterations, repairs, pressing, and quick-change assistance remain hands-on work that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: 3D garment modeling to preview alterations
AI-assisted sizing and pattern-adjustment suggestions
Smart care equipment that adjusts programs by fabric
Production scheduling software synchronized with costume plans
ai_s2_auto: Digital costume records and inventory
Automatic generation of costume lists by performance
RFID tags that track costume locations
Electronic care records
ai_s3_list: Alteration and sewing craft: repair split seams, broken buttons, and waistlines within minutes.
Quick-change pacing: the sequence and every movement must remain exact during a change lasting only seconds.
Fabric-care experience: silk, fur, and sequins each require different handling, and one wrong wash can ruin them.
Rapport with performers: remember who puts on shoes first and who changes ten minutes early.
On-site improvisation: respond to added scenes or missing accessories before curtain time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Records, lists, and logs make up a meaningful share of the work and are moving to digital tools. Alterations, quick changes, and fabric care require hands-on craft, limiting replacement by AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI manages records and lists, freeing time for the minutes before a performance. Stockroom-only roles face pressure, while Costume Attendants who alter garments, understand fabrics, and rescue performances remain valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter the performing arts, study costume design or stagecraft and build strong sewing skills. Do not focus only on software in the AI era. Sewing and fabric knowledge remain indispensable on productions.

Move records into software and build hands-on skills in alterations, construction, and costume design. Gain project experience and advance from costume assistant to costume supervisor rather than remaining in storage work.

People who sew and understand performance have an advantage when changing careers. Starting as a costume assistant in a theater or production is the fastest route. Describe outcomes on your resume, such as managing all costumes for a production without a performance incident.

Test hands-on skill before hiring Costume Attendants. Ask candidates to repair a split seam or adjust a waistline on site. Prioritize people who understand fabrics, solve emergencies, and withstand production-season pressure over those limited to records.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Show costume locations at a glance

ai_s7_trends: Digital records and scheduling are spreading, reducing stockroom-only costume roles and making management skill an advantage.
Alteration, construction, and fabric expertise are becoming core sources of value, increasing demand for attendants who rescue performances.
Performing arts and screen-production work fluctuates, sustaining flexible project-based employment.

body: Costume Attendants inventory, store, clean, press, repair, and organize costumes in theaters, film and television productions, and performance organizations. They assist performers with changes and ensure every costume arrives on time, clean, and complete for each performance or shoot.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can create a costume list instantly and a scan can locate every garment, but when an actor's waistband splits three minutes before the show, your hands still have to sew it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一键排出服装清单、扫一下就知道哪件戏服在哪个架子上，但演员开演前三分钟裤腰崩线了，那针线活还得靠你的手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年服装服务员在岗约 0.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.71 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代服装服务员，但会接管台账、清单和库房管理。剩下的改衣、补缝、熨烫和现场换装协助，全是手上的活，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 3D 服装建模辅助修改预览
AI 协助尺码与版型调整建议
智能洗护设备按面料自动调程序
剧组排期软件同步服装安排
ai_s2_auto: 戏服台账与库存数字化
服装清单按场次自动生成
RFID 标签追踪戏服去向
洗护记录电子化
ai_s3_list: 改衣缝纫手艺：开线、崩扣、改腰身，几分钟内救场。
换装节奏把控：几秒钟的换场时间，顺序、动作都不能乱。
面料洗护经验：真丝、皮草、亮片各有脾气，洗错了就毁了。
与演员的默契：谁的习惯是先穿鞋、谁要提前十分钟换，都得记着。
现场应变：临时加戏、道具缺件，怎么在开场前补上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的台账、清单、记录比重不低，这些正被数字化工具接管；但改衣、换装、洗护是手上的真功夫，AI 替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 帮你管台账、排清单，把时间省给「上场前的那几分钟」。真正被挤压的是「只会登记保管」的纯库房岗；会改衣、懂面料、能救场的服装员，在剧组里是抢手资源。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入演出行业，选服装设计或舞台美术专业，把缝纫工艺学扎实。AI 时代别只学软件，针线活和面料知识是剧组里谁也抢不走的本事。
把台账交给软件，往改衣制作、戏服设计方向练手艺。多跟剧组积累项目经验，从「服装助理」往「服装主管」走，别让岗位停在保管。
会缝纫、懂戏的转行有优势，从剧院或剧组服装助理切入最快。简历写「负责过XX剧目全套戏服、零演出事故」这类成果，比罗列技能有用。
招服装员先考手艺：现场补个开线、改个腰身，立见高下。优先招懂面料、能救场、扛得住演出季高压的人，比招只会登记的强得多。

ai_s7_trends: 台账与排期数字化普及，纯保管型服装岗减少，管理能力成为加分项。
改衣制作与面料专长成为核心价值，能救场的服装员更抢手。
演出与影视行业波动，跟项目走的灵活用工模式持续。

body: 服装服务员在剧院、影视剧组与演出机构负责戏服的清点、保管、清洗、熨烫、修补与整理，并为演员提供换装协助，保证每场演出或拍摄的服装按时、整洁、完整地就位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一键排出服装清单、扫一下就知道哪件戏服在哪个架子上，但演员开演前三分钟裤腰崩线了，那针线活还得靠你的手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can use lidar to calculate every tree's dimensions, but operators still rely on practiced judgment to decide where a tree should fall and how a machine should move through mud.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 30,900 logging-equipment operators employed in 2024, projected to decline to 30,500 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with roughly 4,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $49,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace logging-equipment operators, but it will change how they work. Harvest-area planning, tree measurement, and operating records can be automated, while automatic cutter alignment and assisted positioning enter harvesters. Complex forest terrain and variable equipment conditions leave safety and efficiency dependent on operator judgment and practiced touch.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic cutter alignment and assisted positioning for harvesters
GPS / BeiDou-guided work-route planning
Forest drones assist risk identification
Remote equipment diagnostics and maintenance reminders
ai_s2_auto: Software-based harvest-area planning and cutting design
Lidar automatically measures tree dimensions and volume
Digital work-volume and work-order records
Automatic equipment-operating data collection
ai_s3_list: Tree-fall direction: judge tree shape, wind, and slope instantly.
Mountain-operation judgment: control equipment on steep slopes, mud, and falling-rock terrain.
On-site safety judgment: identify hung trees, broken branches, and unstable harvest areas.
Equipment troubleshooting: no service shop is nearby in the forest, so operators repair minor faults themselves.
Hardiness and adaptability: physical and psychological resilience for long outdoor assignments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score reflects an occupation dominated by heavy-machine operation in forests and mountains. AI primarily automates measurement, recording, and planning, while felling direction, terrain judgment, and field safety remain highly experience-dependent, creating low near-term replacement risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Automatic cutter alignment and digital operations are spreading, increasing demand for operators who run machinery and read data. Old approaches based on brute force without maintenance or recordkeeping face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with a forestry or mechanical technical school and learn equipment principles before entering a forest operation. Mechanization continues replacing manual logging, making young operators of modern harvesting equipment scarce; do not let the hardship of logging deter you.

Master harvester assistance systems and work-record software and learn equipment repair. Advance from operation toward operation plus maintenance plus data skills to gain leverage during harvest-area transitions and new-technology deployment.

Loader and excavator operators face a modest transition barrier, but confirm you can accept remote forest living before entering. On a résumé, list machine models, terrain, and accident records clearly.
Hire for safety records and equipment-maintenance habits, not only machine operation. Operators willing to learn assistance systems and data recording merit higher attendance allowances.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic cutter alignment and timber-volume calculation
Aerial identification of terrain and fallen trees
Digital work orders and production records

ai_s7_trends: Harvester automation and digital operations spread, shifting operators from pure physical work toward combined equipment and data roles.
Forestry mechanization continues replacing manual logging, leaving skilled equipment operators scarce over the long term.
Stricter sustainable-harvesting and environmental requirements make harvest-area planning and precise operations central to the industry.

body: Logging-equipment operators run harvesting, skidding, loading, and related forestry machinery to harvest and transport timber. Their work includes felling, delimbing, cutting to length, skidding, and loading, making them essential to converting forest resources into specified logs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can use lidar to calculate every tree's dimensions, but operators still rely on practiced judgment to decide where a tree should fall and how a machine should move through mud.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能靠激光雷达算出每棵树的尺寸，但「这棵树往哪倒、这台机器在泥地里怎么挪」，还得操作员凭手感定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年设备操作员在岗约 3.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.05 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.42 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代林业设备操作员，但会改变作业方式：伐区规划、树木测量、作业记录都能自动化，采伐机的自动对刀和辅助定位也在进场。但山林地形复杂、设备状态多变，真正决定作业安全与效率的，仍是操作员的手感与判断。
ai_s2_accel: 采伐机自动对刀与辅助定位系统
GPS/北斗引导的作业路线规划
林区无人机巡查辅助风险识别
设备远程诊断与保养提醒
ai_s2_auto: 伐区规划与采伐设计软件化
激光雷达自动测量树木尺寸与材积
作业量与工单记录电子化
设备运行数据自动采集
ai_s3_list: 倒木方向控制：看树形、风向、坡度，瞬间判断。
山地作业手感：陡坡、泥地、落石中的设备控制。
现场安全判断：悬树、断枝、不稳定伐区的识别。
设备故障处理：山里没有售后，小毛病自己修。
吃苦与适应：野外长期作业的体力和心理韧性。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的主体是「山野重机操作」，AI 能自动化的主要是测量、记录和规划；伐倒方向、地形判断、现场安全这些环节仍高度依赖操作员的经验，短期替代风险很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于零变化：自动对刀和作业数据化在普及，未来「会开机器、也能看数据」的操作员更吃香。被挤压的，是只会蛮干、不会保养和记录的老做法。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行先上林业或机械类技校，学扎实设备原理再下林场。机械化替代人工是大趋势，会操作现代化采伐设备的年轻人是稀缺的，别被「伐木苦」吓退。
把采伐机辅助系统、作业记录软件玩熟，学点设备维修。从「会开」升级成「会开 + 会保养 + 会看数据」，在伐区转型和新技术列装时更有议价权。
有装载机、挖掘机操作经验的，转林业设备门槛不高；进林场前先确认你能接受野外驻场的生活节奏。简历里写清你开过的机型、作业过的地形和事故记录。
招人重点看安全记录和设备保养习惯，别只看「会开」。愿意学辅助系统和数据记录的操作员，值得给更高出勤补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 采伐机自动化与作业数据化普及，操作员从「纯体力」转向「设备 + 数据」复合。
林业机械化持续替代人工伐木，熟练设备操作员长期稀缺。
可持续采伐与环保要求趋严，伐区规划与精准作业成为行业主线。

body: 林业设备操作员操作采伐、集材、装载等林业机械完成木材采伐与运输环节，包括伐木、打枝、造材、集材、装车等作业，是把森林资源转化为规格木材的关键技术工种。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能靠激光雷达算出每棵树的尺寸，但「这棵树往哪倒、这台机器在泥地里怎么挪」，还得操作员凭手感定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Medical And Health Services Managers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 616,200 medical and health services managers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 759,100 by 2034. That represents roughly 142,900 additional jobs and about 62,100 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $118,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace medical and health services managers, but it will reshape their workflow. Tools handle repetitive and structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creativity. Scripted execution faces the greatest pressure, while professionals who understand real situations and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate customer or learner assessments for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate solution testing for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Use retrieval to accelerate research and regulatory verification for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination for Medical and Health Services Managers.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Process and classify repetitive Medical and Health Services Managers data.
Conduct rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Search Medical and Health Services Managers knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real Medical and Health Services Managers scenarios.
The ability to explain Medical and Health Services Managers expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in the Medical and Health Services Managers field.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination for Medical and Health Services Managers.
Reusing tacit knowledge from long-term Medical and Health Services Managers experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist Medical and Health Services Managers, but professional judgment and accountable final review are difficult to replace, resulting in 6/10 exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 6/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in Medical and Health Services Managers work and accumulate real project experience.
Connect your existing experience to Medical and Health Services Managers work and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn Medical and Health Services Managers experience into products or management capabilities to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive Medical and Health Services Managers work and focus on decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a plausible philosophy assignment in one minute, but a teacher still has to ask where the argument fails and how the student should think.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 27,300 postsecondary teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 27,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 2,000 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $78,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary philosophy teachers, but it will change assignments and classrooms. AI can generate polished-looking papers and courseware, increasing copied submissions. Teachers must shift assessment from submitting a paper to live defenses, classroom questioning, and process-based evaluation. AI accelerates lesson preparation, research, and material organization, but critical-thinking training and academic judgment still depend on people.

ai_s2_auto: Automated literature searches and information organization

ai_s3_list: Classroom questioning: identify gaps in a student's argument and provide immediate guidance.
Original judgment: AI cannot determine the novelty and weight of an academic view.
Individualized teaching: explain the same concept differently to different students.
Modeling critical thought: demonstrate the process of constructing an argument.
Academic integrity: detect AI-written papers and protect academic standards.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 means that AI is deeply reshaping informational and procedural stages such as research, courseware, and assignment drafts. The occupation's core value in critical thinking, questioning, and judgment remains highly human; the score reflects tool-enabled stages, not the role itself.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Teachers who detect and address AI-written assignments and turn AI into a teaching tool gain time for genuinely deep critical-thinking training. Outdated models based on lecturing from a script and assigning work AI can write are what will disappear.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before choosing philosophy, understand that it is the love of wisdom, not a shortcut to employment. An undergraduate major or minor develops reasoning and writing skills transferable to content, consulting, and civil service. A doctoral path toward teaching requires accepting fierce competition.

Build strength in both publishing and teaching. Use AI to accelerate lesson preparation and literature organization, and invest the saved time in original research. Offer more general education and online courses to expand academic influence.

Career transitions for philosophy backgrounds include humanities content, curriculum design, consulting, brand narrative, and civil service. Do not treat teaching as the only destination; reasoning ability has its own market.

Humanities teaching positions attract many poorly matched applicants. Recruit for teaching ability and AI-era curriculum design, not publication counts alone; general education and humanities literacy courses deserve expansion.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can refine a lead list into individualized profiles and generate flawless scripts, but when a client frowns and says, 'I'll think about it,' the response that brings them back still has to come from your own judgment in the moment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 1,226,700 financial sales workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,264,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 38,000 jobs, with approximately 123,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $66,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate sales as an occupation, but it will remove many people who only make calls and recite scripts. AI already cleans lead lists, makes automated outbound calls, recommends scripts, enters CRM data, and generates quotations faster than people. Those who remain will be consultative sales professionals who understand clients, cultivate relationships, and close complex deals.
ai_s2_accel: Customer profiling tools support needs prediction
Sales forecasting models optimize funnel management
Video conferencing and remote demonstration tools expand sales reach
Short-video and content marketing tools support customer acquisition
ai_s2_auto: Customer-list cleaning and lead scoring
AI outbound-calling robots and script recommendations
Automated CRM entry, follow-up reminders, and reporting
Template-based generation of quotations, proposals, and contracts
ai_s3_list: Needs insight: uncover genuine pain points from fragmentary client comments.
Trust building: a reputation for reliability accumulated through long-term relationships.
Real-time negotiation: the art of protecting price and making concessions when a quote is challenged.
Complex solution presentation: explain a cross-functional decision to a group of stakeholders.
Resilience under pressure: remain effective after repeated rejection.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means AI is taking over much of this occupation's process layer. Lead lists, outbound calls, scripts, and records are all being automated, but sales is fundamentally a transaction between people. Complex B2B services depend on trust and real-time judgment, which AI cannot provide.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is not a death sentence. Purely execution-focused telesales workers will be eliminated because AI can perform all of their tasks. Consultative salespeople who use AI to improve efficiency will thrive: let machines handle screening while you handle negotiations, increasing both efficiency and earning potential.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Sales has a low entry barrier, but do not treat it as a fallback when no other options remain. If you want this career, complete internships and build case experience during college. Learning industry knowledge in finance, IT, or supply chains will save time compared with struggling to acquire it after graduation.

Use AI tools. Automated outbound calls, customer profiling, and sales forecasting will become standard. Do not remain someone who only makes calls; become an industry consultant and build your own customer relationships and reputation, which AI cannot take away.

Sales welcomes people with industry backgrounds. Someone with experience in finance, IT, or logistics who moves into sales is more persuasive than a generalist salesperson. In interviews, do not simply say you work hard; clearly explain which industry you understand and which clients you have closed.

Remove pure outbound-calling roles from headcount and let AI handle those stages. Shift recruiting toward candidates with industry knowledge who can conduct solution-based sales, and provide consultative sellers with better customer resources and commissions.

Automated initial screening and intent assessment
Aggregated company information and demand forecasting
Rapid template-based generation of proposals and quotations
Reach potential customers through short videos and articles
Automated electronic signatures and payment reminders

Sales shifts toward industry consultants and relationship managers, creating clear premiums for people with industry expertise.
Remote sales and content-based customer acquisition become standard, removing city-based limits on sales reach.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年金融销售在岗约 122.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 126.47 万人，净增约 3.80 万个岗位，年均产生约 12.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让销售这个职业消失，但会狠狠洗掉一批「只会打电话、念话术」的人：名单清洗、自动外呼、话术推荐、CRM 录入、报价单生成，这些活 AI 已经干得比人快。留下来的是能读懂客户、经营关系、促成复杂交易的顾问式销售。
ai_s2_accel: 客户画像工具辅助需求预判
销售预测模型优化漏斗管理
视频会议与远程演示工具扩展触达半径
短视频与内容营销工具辅助获客
ai_s2_auto: 客户名单清洗与线索打分
AI 外呼机器人与话术推荐
CRM 录入、跟进提醒与报表自动化
报价单、方案书与合同的模板化生成
ai_s3_list: 需求洞察：从客户只言片语里挖出真实痛点。
信任经营：长期关系里积累的「靠谱」口碑。
临场谈判：报价被砍时守价、让价的艺术。
复杂方案讲解：把跨部门决策讲给一群人听。
抗压韧性：连续被拒之后还能状态在线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的「过程环节」正被 AI 大面积接管：名单、外呼、话术、记录都自动化了，但销售本质是人与人的交易，复杂 B2B 服务离不开信任和临场判断，这正是 AI 给不了的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于判死刑：被淘汰的是「纯执行型电销」，因为他们的全部工作 AI 都能干。吃香的是「会用 AI 提效的顾问型销售」——让机器负责筛、你负责谈，效率上去了，收入上限也上去了。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 销售门槛低，但别把它当「没别的选择」的退路。想干这行，大学期间就去实习攒案例，学点行业知识（金融、IT、供应链），比毕业后再摸爬滚打省时间。
把 AI 工具用起来：自动外呼、客户画像、销售预测都会成为标配。别只当「打电话的」，往行业顾问转，攒你的客户资产和口碑，这是 AI 拿不走的。
销售欢迎有行业背景的人：做过金融、IT、物流的转销售，比纯销售更有说服力。面试时别说「我能吃苦」，说清你懂什么行业、怎么成交过什么客户。
把「纯外呼岗」从编制里砍掉，用 AI 接住这些环节；招聘重点转向有行业知识、能做方案型销售的候选人，同时给顾问型销售配更好的客户资源和提成。

销售向「行业顾问 + 关系经营者」转型，懂行业的人溢价明显。
远程销售与内容获客成为标配，销售半径不再受城市限制。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 29,300 education teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 29,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 2,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $62,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace preschool special education teachers, but it will take over assessment and documentation. AI is rapidly handling developmental assessment scales, IEP drafts, intervention records, and parent reports. One-on-one individualized instruction, behavioral intervention, and emotional support remain the human core and cannot be replaced by machines.
ai_s2_accel: AI speech and behavior analysis supports assessment
Digital rehabilitation training and interactive teaching aids
Online family-school collaboration and video guidance
Intelligent recommendations for evidence-based intervention strategies
ai_s2_auto: Automated scoring and reporting for developmental assessment scales
Generation of IEP drafts and intervention records
Automated organization of instructional materials and teaching-aid plans
Batch production of family-school communications and progress reports
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment during one-on-one intervention: the child's mood and condition today determine how the session proceeds.
Immediate response during behavioral intervention: only a person can respond to and stabilize a child during an emotional crisis.
Trust building: a child's willingness to cooperate develops through long-term interaction.
In-depth communication with parents: explaining slow progress while preserving hope without increasing anxiety is an art.
Multidisciplinary collaboration: coordination with therapists, physicians, and general classroom teachers cannot be replaced.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means assessment, documentation, and lesson planning form a substantial share of this occupation, and AI is rapidly taking over those tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI makes assessment and planning faster, pushing teachers toward the intervention setting, where AI cannot enter. Roles that only write plans without conducting training will face pressure, while special education teachers who understand evidence-based intervention and can work directly with children remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Special education is a scarce field supported by policy. Build a strong foundation in child development, behavioral intervention, and assessment while completing extensive internships in resource rooms and rehabilitation organizations. In the AI era, demand for teachers who can assess and intervene will continue to rise.

Use AI for assessment and documentation, returning time to one-on-one intervention and family-school communication. Study evidence-based intervention methods such as ABA and sensory integration and advance toward resource-room leadership, curriculum development, or rehabilitation supervision.

People with backgrounds in early childhood education, rehabilitation, nursing, or psychology have advantages when transitioning. First earn a special education or early childhood teaching credential and begin as an individual-training teacher or assistant. On a resume, specify how many IEPs you developed and which types of cases you supported.

Do not recruit special education teachers based only on credentials. Ask them to work with a child in emotional crisis to reveal their true capability. Teachers who understand assessment, conduct interventions, and communicate with parents deserve better compensation and supervision support.

Automated generation of records and reports

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over assessment and documentation, returning teachers' energy to one-on-one intervention and increasing professional value.
As inclusive education policies advance, demand continues to grow for special education resource rooms and professional teachers in preschools.
Evidence-based intervention and family-school collaboration become standard, making versatile professionals who can assess and supervise even scarcer.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 2.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.97 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.22 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学前特教教师，但会接管评估与文档。发育评估量表、IEP 初稿、干预记录、家长报告，这些正被 AI 快速代劳。剩下的一对一个别化教学、行为干预、情感支持，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 语音与行为分析辅助评估
数字化康复训练与互动教具
在线家校协同与视频指导
循证干预策略的智能推荐
ai_s2_auto: 发育评估量表自动计分与报告
IEP 初稿与干预记录生成
教学资料与教具方案自动整理
家校沟通文档与进度报告批量产出
ai_s3_list: 一对一干预的现场判断：孩子今天的情绪、状态，决定了这节课怎么上。
行为干预的即时反应：情绪崩溃的当下，接住它、稳住它，只能靠人。
建立信任关系：孩子愿意配合你，是长期相处养出来的。
与家长的深度沟通：把「慢」讲清楚、让家长有希望又不焦虑，是门艺术。
多学科协作：跟康复师、医生、普通班老师对接，人的协调不可替代。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的评估、文档、教案比重不小，这些正被 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让评估和写计划变快，反而把老师推向「干预现场」——那正是 AI 进不去的地方。真正被挤压的是「只会写计划、不会带训练」的岗位，懂循证干预、能现场带孩子的特教老师依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 特教专业是政策扶持的稀缺方向。读专业时把儿童发展、行为干预和评估方法学扎实，多去资源教室和康复机构实习；AI 时代，会评估、懂干预的老师需求只增不减。
把 AI 用于评估和文档，省下时间做一对一干预和家校沟通。学循证干预方法（如 ABA、感觉统合），往资源教室负责人、教研或康复督导方向发展。
有幼教、康复、护理或心理背景者转型有优势。先考特教或幼教资格证，从个训教师或助教做起，简历里多写「制定过XX份 IEP、干预过XX类个案」。
招特教老师别只看证书，现场带一个情绪崩溃的孩子最能看出成色。懂评估、会干预、能跟家长沟通的老师，值得给更好的待遇和督导支持。

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管评估与文档，特教老师的精力回到一对一干预现场，专业价值上升。
融合教育政策推进，幼儿园特教资源教室与专业教师岗位需求持续增长。
循证干预与家校协同成为标配，懂评估、能督导的复合型人才更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically lay out nesting plans and CNC machines can cut every plate, but an experienced fabricator's hands are still needed to fit two beams together perfectly on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 53,800 structural metal fabricators were employed in 2024, projected to decrease to 45,000 by 2034, a net loss of about 8,800 jobs, with about 4,100 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $49,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will replace drawing layout, nesting optimization, and CNC material cutting, but not the occupation as a whole. Robots can cut plates and weld seams, yet they struggle to flexibly level, align, and accommodate deviations in custom components on an assembly table. Automated factories most need fabricators who read drawings, understand assembly tolerances, and resolve field deviations.
ai_s2_accel: Three-dimensional scanning for assembly leveling
Digital layout and on-site comparison
AI quality inspection for weld and dimensional defects
Prefabricated component libraries and automated drawings
ai_s2_auto: Automated BIM and nesting layouts for material cutting
CNC plasma and laser cutting
Robotic welding replacing manual tack welding
Automated component dimension inspection and recording
ai_s3_list: Assembly precision: Dimensional and geometric tolerances at the millimeter level depend on skilled hands.
Handling field deviations: Experience is essential for cutting errors, distortion correction, and custom conditions.
Drawing interpretation: Complex connections and assembly sequences require a thorough understanding of drawings.
Rigging coordination: Turning and positioning large components requires smooth human-machine coordination.
Distortion control: Workers must anticipate and counteract distortion caused by welding and cutting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates a partially automated occupation. AI has high involvement in data-driven cutting and layout, but core assembly, leveling, and field adjustments still depend entirely on hands-on experience, keeping overall exposure low.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not permit standing still because factory digitization is advancing rapidly. Fabricators who use nesting software, interpret three-dimensional models, and work with robotic production lines are far more competitive than peers limited to manual cutting. Digital tools can magnify the advantage represented by a score of 4.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose steel structures, riveting and welding, or mechanical assembly at a technical school, prioritizing drawing interpretation and CNC equipment. Manufacturing needs skilled blue-collar workers who understand drawings and operate intelligent equipment, while software is gradually replacing manual layout.

Learn nesting software, CNC cutting, and three-dimensional drawing interpretation instead of relying only on manual skills. Advance toward high-precision assembly and team management. Both construction sites and factories need experienced workers who lead crews and define processes.

A background in machinery or welding makes entry easier. Begin as a factory apprentice and focus on drawing interpretation and assembly. Welding certificates and fitter skill-level credentials can substantially improve bargaining power.

As automated cutting spreads, hiring should focus on technicians who read drawings, understand assembly precision, and handle field deviations. Use skill-based pay and apprenticeships to retain younger workers.

ai_s7_trends: As prefabricated construction and steel structures expand, factory-based standardized component production is accelerating and demand for high-precision assembly is growing.
BIM layout and CNC cutting are becoming widespread, shifting workshop personnel from manual layout to digital operation and on-site assembly.
Robotic welding and intelligent inspection are entering production lines, increasing demand for versatile fabricators who combine drawing interpretation, assembly, and equipment skills.

body: Structural metal fabricators follow drawings and process requirements to lay out, cut, drill, form, assemble, and level steel. They fit and tack-weld components to supply qualified parts for structural steel installation in buildings and engineering projects.

ai_s3_list: 装配精度：尺寸公差和形位公差，毫米级的活儿靠手。
现场偏差处理：下料误差、变形校正，非标情况靠经验。

吊装配合：大件翻身、就位，人机配合要默契。
变形控制：焊接和切割引起的变形，要能预判和反变形处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这是个「半自动化」岗位：可数据化的下料和排版环节 AI 参与度高，但核心的装配、校平、现场处理依然是纯手工经验，整体曝光不高。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不代表可以原地踏步——厂内数字化在快速普及。会用套料软件、看得懂三维模型、能配合机器人产线的制造工，比只会手工下料的同行吃香得多；把数字化工具用起来，4 分的优势能放大成竞争力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走技校选钢结构、铆焊、机械装配方向，优先学读图和数控设备。制造业缺的是能看懂图纸、会操作智能设备的蓝领技术人才，纯手工放样慢慢会被软件替代。
把套料软件、数控切割和三维看图学起来，别只会手工。往高精度装配和班组管理走，工地和厂里都缺能带班、能定工艺的老师傅。
有机械、焊接基础的最好上手。进厂从学徒做起，重点练读图和装配；考焊工证、装配工等级证能明显提升议价空间。
自动化下料普及后，招聘重心应转向「会看图、懂装配精度、能处理现场偏差」的技师。建议用技能等级工资和学徒传帮带留住年轻力量。

ai_s7_trends: 装配式建筑与钢结构占比上升，构件工厂化、标准化生产加速，高精度装配需求增长。
BIM 放样与数控下料普及，车间人员从手工放样转向数字化操作与现场装配。
机器人焊接与智能检测进入产线，技能复合型制造工（看图+装配+设备）更吃香。

body: 结构金属制造工按照图纸和工艺要求，对钢材进行放样、切割、钻孔、成形、装配与校平，并完成构件组对与点焊，为建筑和工程的钢结构安装提供合格部件。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动排版套料、数控切出每一块板，但「这两根梁在现场要严丝合缝地拼上」——这个准头，还得靠老师傅的手。
